caption: Model Response
description: One source record reporting content of a model response. A response with several records yields several events sharing response_uid; assembly is a query, not a stored claim. When the source reports only its own content items (item_uid), the response they belong to is not identified: two items are not two model invocations, nor one.
name: model_response

1.caption: Partial
1.description: The record reports a non-final view of the response (no terminal stop reason or state).

2.caption: Completed
2.description: The record reports a terminal state for the response.

3.caption: Item completed
3.description: The source reports a completed content item of a model response (for example a Codex exec agent message or reasoning item). The response it belongs to, and that response's own state, are not reported.

cli_agent.description: The CLI agent is stored once per run in run.json shared.cli_agent (0.2.0); it is present on an event only in a self-contained export.

identity_basis_id.description: What kind of identifier item_uid is, when a declared rule states it.

basis.description: Rules applied by the mapping: the activity_id rule and, when the source reports no response identifier, the declared generation rule for response_uid.

assembly.description: Present in a finally assembled file: this event's assembly role and evidence.

data.description: Native record fields not represented elsewhere on the event (residual).

duration.description: The source-reported elapsed execution time in integral milliseconds. No start/end timestamps or aggregation window are inferred. Exact non-integral durations use execution_metrics in their native unit.
